name: FUN_ALLOC_STEP_EXEC_HISTORY
description: This table contains the status or result for each step of the allocation process that is processed.

columns.name: STEP_EXECUTION_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier for allocation process step execution history.

columns.name: STEP_NAME
columns.description: Indicates the name of Allocation Step.

columns.name: STEP_DESCRIPTION
columns.description: Description of the Allocation Process Step.

columns.name: STEP_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Type of the Allocation Process Step. Possible values are Allocation, Formula, and Reclass.

columns.name: CONTROL_POINT_STEP_ID
columns.description: Identifies the Allocation Step which refers to control point step.

columns.name: CONTROL_POINT_EXECUTION_ID
columns.description: Identifies the Allocation Step which refers to control point step.

columns.name: RESULT_SET_ID
columns.description: Identifies the Result Set of Allocation Process Type.

columns.name: STATUS_CODE
columns.description: Status of Step Execution. Possible values are COMPLETED, RUNNING, and FAILED.

columns.name: ERROR_MESSAGE
columns.description: Error message details when the step fails.

columns.name: START_TIME
columns.description: Start time of the step execution history

columns.name: END_TIME
columns.description: End time of the step execution history

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.
